captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional telephoto camera lens, featuring a long cylindrical white barrel with a front black lens cap and a rear mount. A prominent black focus ring is located near the front of the lens barrel, allowing for manual adjustment. Towards the rear, a white tripod collar ring with an integrated mounting foot wraps around the barrel. The tripod collar and the focus ring are designed to rotate independently around the main longitudinal axis of the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a long white telephoto prime lens. It must include a main lens barrel, a rotatable black focus ring near the front, and a rotatable white tripod collar ring with a flat mounting foot near the rear. Define revolute joints for both the focus ring and the tripod collar about the central lens axis.
captions.factory: The object is constructed by defining three main parts: the static lens barrel, the focus ring, and the tripod collar. The main barrel is built from coaxial cylinders of varying radii, with a small box protrusion for alignment marks and a red sphere for the mounting index. The focus ring is modeled as a hollow cylinder (by subtracting an inner cylinder from an outer one) with a black material. The tripod collar is constructed similarly using boolean subtraction of cylinders, combined with a rectangular box for the tripod foot. Two revolute joints are established along the central Z-axis to allow independent rotation of the focus ring and the tripod collar.
